claims.text: R31 permissions: with umask 022, the case root, cases/, the case folder, inputs/ and statements/ are 0700, no file under the case folder (profile, statement, case log and its head/gate/lock files) is readable or writable by group or others, and the imported original is 0400. An existing root opened to others is set back to 0700.

R31 git-ignore: a case root inside a git working tree that does not ignore it, or a root that is the working tree itself, is refused before anything is made (library and `cma case new`, which exits 2). The same holds for a tree git cannot be asked about, and for an existing root that later stops being ignored, at every command. A root that git ignores (cma/, cma, /cma/, private/) is allowed.

Log entries (R42): `cma case new --demo --label` prints a random 16-hex id and appends case_created (case id, demo flag, profile hash; no label text). `cma case profile` validates and writes case.yaml and appends profile_changed (changed fields and profile hash); an unchanged profile appends nothing. `cma case import` for csv and monzo appends an import entry (account, format, input and statement sha256, lines, period). `cma case check` stays at exit 0.
claims.proof_cmd: python -m pytest tests/test_case_store.py -q -k 'logs or logged or keeps_the_original or monzo_import'

claims.text: Profile validation: unknown or repeated keys, separator-only names, non-list name fields, duplicate names, a non-boolean demo, vat_stagger outside 1-3, and a repayment with more than two decimals, at or below zero, at the £10tn limit or boolean are each refused, and nothing changes. --from replaces the whole profile.

Import: the original goes into inputs/<sha256>.<ext> and the statement into statements/<account>.csv, checked by ingest.load_csv. The same file again leaves the case and its log head unchanged. A refused statement (a bad number, or the R2 limit), a broken log (exit 3), a log refusal (files put back), a second statement for one account, or a bad account key leaves the case as it was.
claims.proof_cmd: python -m pytest tests/test_case_store.py -q -k 'import or account or statement'

claims.text: The new contract tests pass under the contracts marker.
Full suite, ruff and compileall pass with the change.
claims.proof_cmd: ruff check src tests && python -m compileall -q src && python -m pytest -q

notes: Changes are left uncommitted in the worktree. New module src/cma/store.py (C3 case store) is called by the new CLI commands `cma case new`, `cma case profile CASE` and `cma case import CASE FILE --format csv|monzo`, which take the case id, not a folder. `cma case check` still takes a folder, as T12 left it. Choices the reviewer may weigh: (1) Importing an already-imported file appends nothing (R39 and P9 ask for the same log head). The Failure-modes row 'the log notes it was already imported' would contradict P9, so P9 was followed. (2) A second statement for an account that already has one is refused, naming --account; overlap detection and multi-account limits are R40 and R41 (Tier 2). (3) The profile has label, demo, business_name, directors, shareholders, own_accounts, vat_stagger and proposed_monthly_repayment (stored as exact pounds text). profile_names() merges directors and shareholders into ProfileNames.directors for R5. Nothing in production passes a profile to the categoriser yet; that is T05's. (4) The log records the profile's hash and changed field names, never names. (5) The git check runs `git check-ignore` on the root path with a trailing slash, from the nearest folder that holds .git; with GIT_* variables removed. A tree git cannot answer about is refused. (6) Case-log files are 0600 because case.py creates them so; this task changed nothing in case.py.
